facts.text: Sit down, Jimmy. Eat something and don't lose the money this time.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Pando's words, but it is not a line from the film. It works as a note in his voice, since Jimmy loses his ten grand at Bondi.
facts.fix: Sit down, Jimmy. Eat something, and keep your hands on my ten grand this time.

fix_note.text: Sit down, Jimmy. Eat something, and keep your hands on my ten grand this time.

facts.text: the gangster's crew killing time at his place
facts.why: Pando's crew is Acko and Wally, but no scene of them killing time at his place shows in the sources opened.
facts.fix: Acko and Wally's crew waiting on Jimmy

facts.text: Jimmy's feed before that swim at Bondi.
facts.why: Jimmy waits at Bondi and goes for a swim, but no feed beforehand is mentioned.
facts.fix: Eaten fast, because Jimmy has a ten grand envelope to drop at Bondi.

facts.text: the family house out in the suburbs
facts.why: The suburban house in the plot is Deirdre's, where the bank job is planned. Jimmy's brother is dead and no family Sunday roast is described.
facts.fix: Deirdre's suburban kitchen, where the bank job gets planned

vibe.verdict: Kings Cross bar tab is on theme, but most of the film's plot beats are missing.
missing: Jimmy burying the envelope in the sand (Bondi)
Street kids Pete and Helen stealing the cash
Wozza's failed jump over the counter
Jimmy's brother Michael as guardian angel
ideas: Swap 'Pando's crew potato scallops' note for 'Wozza's counter jump gone wrong'.
Swap 'Bondi fish and chips' note for 'the beach where the envelope went missing'.
Add Acko's Ford Falcon as a run slip stamp.
